# Colecto v0.4.0

The Android app now feels like an Android app, the first launch walks you through
adding an account, mail opens faster, and an optional AI assistant can summarize,
reply and label.

## Mobile

- **Back works like a native app:** the back button and back gesture close the newest
  thing first (a dropdown, a dialog, a Settings page, Settings, an open message) and
  only leave the app from the inbox. The in-app back arrows do the same.
- **Predictive back on Android:** the screen shrinks under your finger as you swipe
  and shows what it will go back to; swipe away to cancel. Android's own
  back-to-home preview does not play yet. On iOS, swipe from the left edge.
- **Press sounds and haptics:** taps play the system click on Android, and switches and
  choices give a light tick, when touch sounds and touch feedback are on in Android's
  settings.
- **Layouts for every window size:** phones get a bottom bar for Inbox, Drafts and Sent;
  tablets in portrait, foldables and phones on their side get a side rail; wider
  windows keep the dockable workspace. See
  [adaptive layout](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/DESIGN.md#adaptive-layout).
- **Settings on a phone** open on a list of sections, and each opens over it. On wider
  screens the section list is a sidebar you can collapse to icons.
- **Motion:** messages, the composer and Settings pages slide in and back out.
- **Easier to read:** text on touch screens is one size larger by default, keyboard
  hints such as `Esc` and `Ctrl K` are gone, and taps no longer leave buttons
  highlighted.
- The loading logo is centred.

These were checked in browser tests and the Android and iOS builds, but not yet on a
real phone. Please report anything that feels off.

## Getting started

- **Onboarding:** the first launch helps you add an account before showing the
  workspace. The sample account is off until you choose to explore with it.
- **Turn accounts on and off** in Settings → Accounts. An account that is off is hidden
  and never refreshed. See
  [accounts](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/accounts.md#first-run-and-turning-accounts-on-or-off).

## Faster mail

- Messages are kept on your device, the newest Inbox mail is downloaded after each
  refresh (Settings → Mail), and switching folders shows the last list at once. See
  [opening mail quickly](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/accounts.md#opening-mail-quickly).
- The message list footer shows how the account syncs (push, IDLE or polling) and its
  progress.
- The desktop app can connect to a remote daemon over HTTPS from Settings → Connection.

## Optional AI

Off by default. With any OpenAI-compatible model you can **Summarize** a message,
draft a **Reply** in one of five tones, and **auto-label** mail with rules and,
optionally, yes/no decisions. See
[AI](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/ai.md). Only tested
against mocked servers so far.

## Also

- Message list density (full, medium, compact) and optional date headings in
  Settings → Appearance.
- A notification when a new version is out (Notifications → New updates).
- Install an extension by dropping its `.colectoext` on the Extensions page.
- Notifications show above Settings; the sample Inbox comes back after unlocking
  credentials; overlay extensions survive a daemon restart.

## Downloads and limits

Downloads are not code-signed; see
[installing](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/install.md). The
[known limits](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.4.0/docs/roadmap.md)
still apply, and storage formats may change between alpha versions.
